I built a Grok @bot called Pain in the Task.https://t.co/lHGNqlYNZU

You give it something you do on repeat that you hate, procrastinate on, or wish you could hand off. It interviews you (not a form), diagnoses the actual workflow, and prescribes the right kind of help.…

— Dave Gambrill (@gambrill) August 29, 2026
